result.note: Tests where the Iranian vessel was given refuge and the facts around the IRIS Dena sinking after MILAN 2026, India's flagship naval exercise.

questions.prompt: In March 2026, India allowed the Iranian naval vessel IRIS Lavan, which had reported engine failure, to dock at which Indian port?
questions.explain: The IRIS Lavan docked in Kochi on 4 March 2026 and remained there under Indian supervision. External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar framed the decision as a humanitarian necessity rather than a political statement.
questions.source: allow the Iranian naval vessel IRIS Lavan to dock in Kochi, framing the move as a humanitarian necessity rather than a political statement

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about the Iranian frigate IRIS Dena, sunk in March 2026:
items: It was sunk by a US submarine about 40 miles off the Sri Lankan coast.
It had participated in India's MILAN 2026 naval exercises shortly before it was sunk.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explain: A US submarine sank the IRIS Dena off Sri Lanka on 4 March 2026 as part of Operation Epic Fury, just after it left India following the MILAN 2026 exercises. Sri Lankan authorities recovered 87 bodies from the strike.
questions.source: The IRIS Dena had just departed India after participating in New Delhi’s flagship MILAN 2026 exercises
